**Coach’s Response:**

*"Ram, I appreciate you sharing that with me. One meal or one day doesn’t define your progress—what matters is how you bounce back. Tomorrow is a fresh start, and I know you’ve got the discipline to fuel your body right. Focus on nourishing foods, stay hydrated, and trust the process. You’re stronger than a single off day. Let’s make tomorrow count—you’ve got this!"*

*(Tone: Encouraging, supportive, and forward-focused.)*
